title: Outcome/usage dashboard (privacy-preserving, aggregate)
context: The outcomes ledger records adoption and reuse events per explainer (outcomes/<explainer-id>.json). A privacy-preserving, aggregate dashboard over this ledger lets the Steward and community track adoption progress at a glance. No end-user PII may be collected or displayed; only aggregate recorded adoption events from the committed ledger are shown. Static, client-side, no tracking services.
objective: Build a privacy-preserving, aggregate outcome/usage dashboard that reads the committed outcomes ledger and displays adoption progress without collecting or displaying any end-user PII.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard reads the outcomes ledger (outcomes/<explainer-id>.json files committed to the repo); no end-user PII collected or displayed.
Privacy-preserving by design: aggregate counts only; no cookies, no user identifiers, no personal data, no tracking services.
Static, client-side tool: no backend, no database, no runtime server.
Code is MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; commit is DCO signed-off.
Dashboard committed to the project repo as a PR and linked from the project README.
resources: PLAN.md — Security & privacy section (privacy-preserving usage measurement)
toolkit-002 (prerequisite — shared toolkit must exist for the static scaffold)
output: A committed outcome/usage dashboard (static, client-side code + build config) submitted as a PR, reading the outcomes ledger and linked from the README.
